  b_sysreg_flags <= b_sysreg_flags; 
  end 
  else begin 
  if(!iPREV_BUSY && iPREV_INST_VALID)begin 
  if(iPREV_FLAG_WRITE)begin

  b_sysreg_flags <= iSHIFT_FLAG;
